why: Bears had all but vanished from the Chisos by 1944 and recolonized from Mexico's Sierra del Carmen in the late 1980s; about 30-40 now live in the park.
A small isolated subspecies, generally considered the smallest continental deer in North America.
In Texas it lives almost only in the Chisos Mountains, at the northeastern edge of its range.
Called the signature bird of the Chisos; nests on high cliffs, and parts of the South Rim close each nesting season.
